options.content:
## Quick Reference

### Applying CPU/Memory Changes

```yaml
# In your deployment.yaml
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: "<Target value>"       # Blue column - recommended request
    memory: "<Target value>"    # Blue column - recommended request
  limits:
    cpu: "<Upper value>"        # Purple column - recommended limit  
    memory: "<Upper value>"     # Purple column - recommended limit
```

### kubectl Quick Commands

```bash
# View current resources
kubectl get deployment <name> -n <namespace> -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[*].resources}'

# Patch resources directly
kubectl set resources deployment/<name> -n <namespace> \
  --requests=cpu=<target>,memory=<target> \
  --limits=cpu=<upper>,memory=<upper>
```

### Priority Order

1. **Fix Under-Provisioned First** (Red) - These are at risk of OOM/throttling
2. **Apply High-Savings Changes** (Green) - Biggest $ impact
3. **Review Yellow Items** - Validate before changing

### Cost Assumptions

- CPU: ~$0.033/core/hour (GCP E2 equivalent)
- Memory: ~$0.0044/GB/hour
- Monthly = hourly × 730 hours
